title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Shrek?
description:
Ten real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Shrek, through Hindenburg, the Kaiser, Teddy Roosevelt, every president to Reagan, Arnold, Obama, King Charles, Mark Carney and Mike Myers.

Adolf Hitler → Paul von Hindenburg → Wilhelm II, German Emperor → Theodore Roosevelt → Ronald Reagan → Arnold Schwarzenegger → Barack Obama → Charles III → Mark Carney → Mike Myers → Shrek

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
